**Goal.** Put the mangrove design onto a map, see how close DistReef is to being a coordinate, then simulate a spatial truth and fit it three ways. This is where the two papers meet: the location intercept becomes one basis-function choice among several.

## Checklist

- [ ] Build location coordinates in metres
- [ ] Collinearity check: DistReef ~ x + y, and DistReef ~ first 5 eigenvectors of R(ϕ)
- [ ] Write `sim_stage2()` in `sim/stage2.R` (exponential, ϕ = 250 m, small nugget)
- [ ] Fit three models: iid, glmmTMB `exp()`, mgcv `s(x, y)`
- [ ] Scenario B: field partly aligned with DistReef
- [ ] Stretch: DIY eigenvector-basis fit

```{r}
#| label: setup
source("../sim/_load.R")
library(glmmTMB)
library(mgcv)
HTrees1 <- read.table(file.path(data_dir, "abundance.tree.and.controls.txt"),
                      header = TRUE, dec = ".")
```

## 4. Fit three models

- The authors' iid model (`1 | LocationID`)
- glmmTMB with `exp(pos + 0 | group)`
- mgcv with `s(x, y, k = 10)` + `s(LocationID, bs = "re")`, `family = nb()`. Note that this is **NB2**, not NB1.

**Done when:** a table of Treatment and DistReef estimates ± SE from all three fits to the same data set.
